images.title: Two leftovers make a pair
images.purpose: Show that two odd numbers added leave no counter over, because their two leftovers make one pair.
images.composition: Groups of 9 and 13 counters, each with one ringed leftover, and the two leftovers joining into one new pair.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. Two groups, each with one leftover counter, joining into a new pair. LEFT GROUP: 5 counters in a top row at y 200 to 260 starting at x 100, and 4 counters in a bottom row at y 275 to 335 starting at x 100, each counter a circle of 60 px diameter filled teal #0072B2, outlined dark #2B2B2B 3 px, with 15 px between neighbours; the fifth counter of the top row (x 400 to 460) has no partner and is circled by an amber #E69F00 ring (6 px, 80 px diameter). The number 9 in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (80 px) is centred above it at x 280, y 130. RIGHT GROUP: 7 counters in a top row at y 200 to 260 starting at x 800, and 6 counters in a bottom row at y 275 to 335 starting at x 800, the same style; the seventh counter of the top row (x 1250 to 1310) has no partner and is ringed in amber. The number 13 in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (80 px) is centred above it at x 1055, y 130. One thick dark arrow (6 px) pointing down at x 728 from y 380 to y 470, with the label leftovers join in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (44 px) at x 880, y 425. BELOW: a rounded rectangle outlined green #009E73 (5 px), x 680 to 776, y 505 to 670, holding two counters in the same teal style, one above the other (x 698 to 758, y 520 to 580 and y 595 to 655), with the label one new pair in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (44 px) at x 980, y 590. At the bottom, centred at x 728, y 750, the line 9 + 13 = 22 in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (84 px). No other text. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
more or fewer than two ringed counters
any pair other than the two leftovers in the bottom rectangle
images.takeaway: Two odd numbers each have 1 left over, and the two leftovers make a pair: the sum is even.
images.description: Groups of 9 and 13 counters with one leftover each, an arrow marked leftovers join, and one new pair.
images.context: Concept image for Adding Even and Odd Numbers, using the example's own numbers (practice values).
images.teaching_notes: Point at the two ringed counters, then at the new pair. The slip to watch: thinking two odd numbers make an odd number.

image_decisions.why: The leftovers joining into a pair is the whole reason.
